Bag option 3's generated play icon is incidental: use a text-only Use item label or an appropriate item-action icon, never imply Start focus.
Match the existing pixel sprites, avoid stretching, and keep the approved no-permanent-major-separator rule.
Options 2 and 3 show the resting state before confirmation; option 1 explicitly shows the confirmation state.
User requested Pokemon as the main hero. The revised current-Pokemon hero supersedes the original item-art hierarchy and the earlier small-Pokemon constraint for Bag.
